passages.text: Hallelujah! Sing to the LORD a new song— His praise in the assembly of the godly.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD is worthy of praise.
Hallelujah means "Praise the LORD."
Sing a new song to the LORD.
Praise the LORD together.
Gather with the godly people.
Praise the LORD in the assembly.
passages.original: הַ֥לְלוּ יָ֨הּ׀ שִׁ֣ירוּ לַֽ֭יהוָה שִׁ֣יר חָדָ֑שׁ תְּ֝הִלָּת֗וֹ בִּקְהַ֥ל חֲסִידִֽים׃

passages.text: Let Israel rejoice in their Maker; let the children of Zion rejoice in their King.
passages.sermon:
Israel is God's people.
God made Israel.
Israel should rejoice in God, their Maker.
The children of Zion belong to Israel.
God is their King.
The children of Zion should rejoice in their King.
passages.original: יִשְׂמַ֣ח יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל בְּעֹשָׂ֑יו בְּנֵֽי־ צִ֝יּ֗וֹן יָגִ֥ילוּ בְמַלְכָּֽם׃

passages.text: Let them praise His name with dancing, and make music to Him with tambourine and harp.
passages.sermon:
The people praise the LORD’s name.
They dance as they praise Him.
They make music for the LORD.
They use tambourines and harps to make music for Him.
passages.original: יְהַֽלְל֣וּ שְׁמ֣וֹ בְמָח֑וֹל בְּתֹ֥ף וְ֝כִנּ֗וֹר יְזַמְּרוּ־ לֽוֹ׃

passages.text: For the LORD takes pleasure in His people; He adorns the afflicted with salvation.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD loves His people.
The LORD finds joy in His people.
The LORD gives salvation to the humble.
The LORD makes the afflicted beautiful with salvation.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ רוֹצֶ֣ה יְהוָ֣ה בְּעַמּ֑וֹ יְפָאֵ֥ר עֲ֝נָוִ֗ים בִּישׁוּעָֽה׃

passages.text: Let the saints exult in glory; let them shout for joy upon their beds.
passages.sermon:
The saints are God’s faithful people.
The saints feel great joy.
The saints rejoice in honor.
The saints sing for joy.
The saints sing while they rest on their beds.
passages.original: יַעְלְז֣וּ חֲסִידִ֣ים בְּכָב֑וֹד יְ֝רַנְּנ֗וּ עַל־ מִשְׁכְּבוֹתָֽם׃

passages.text: May the high praises of God be in their mouths, and a double-edged sword in their hands, to inflict vengeance on the nations and punishment on the peoples, to bind their kings with chains and their nobles with shackles of iron, to execute the judgment written against them. This honor is for all His saints. Hallelujah!
passages.sermon:
God’s saints praise Him.
They speak high praises of God with their mouths.
They hold a double-edged sword in their hands.
They carry out vengeance on the nations.
They bring punishment on the peoples.
They bind the kings of the nations with chains.
They bind the nobles of the nations with iron shackles.
They execute the judgment that is written against them.
God gives this honor to all His saints.
Hallelujah!
passages.original: רוֹמְמ֣וֹת אֵ֭ל בִּגְרוֹנָ֑ם וְחֶ֖רֶב פִּֽיפִיּ֣וֹת בְּיָדָֽם׃ לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת נְ֭קָמָה בַּגּוֹיִ֑ם תּֽ֝וֹכֵחֹ֗ת בַּל־ אֻמִּֽים׃ לֶאְסֹ֣ר מַלְכֵיהֶ֣ם בְּזִקִּ֑ים וְ֝נִכְבְּדֵיהֶ֗ם בְּכַבְלֵ֥י בַרְזֶֽל׃ לַעֲשׂ֤וֹת בָּהֶ֨ם׀ מִשְׁפָּ֬ט כָּת֗וּב הָדָ֣ר ה֭וּא לְכָל־ חֲסִידָ֗יו הַֽלְלוּ־ יָֽהּ׃
